title: Electronic Signature System (TTE)
description: Enterprise signing flow with deployment ownership and release automation.
fullDescription: A high-stakes digital signature platform rebuilt around Nuxt architecture, biometric verification, and secure deployment workflows. The goal was simple: make a regulated system feel fast, trustworthy, and easier to operate.

title: Web Application Maintenance
description: Reliability work for a live platform: fixes, hardening, and speed.
fullDescription: Continuous upkeep for a busy production system. I focused on reducing technical debt, tightening security, improving query performance, and keeping regression risk low through repeatable checks.

title: Industry Grading System
description: Compliance grading engine with certificates, rules, and access control.
fullDescription: A certification and scoring platform built for industrial workflows. The system handled real-time calculation, PDF generation, and strict role-based access while keeping the interface practical for daily use.

title: Company Profile Website
description: Corporate presence with motion-heavy storytelling and responsive polish.
fullDescription: A branded company showcase built to project trust, clarity, and momentum. I used compact motion systems and smooth scrolling to turn standard content into a more memorable presentation layer.

title: IT Helpdesk System
description: Ticket triage dashboard with auth, alerts, and reporting.
fullDescription: An internal operations tool designed to keep support moving. The dashboard made it easier to sort requests, route critical issues, and stay ahead of the backlog with minimal friction.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Personal showcase built as a kinetic UI experiment.
fullDescription: The site you are currently visiting. This version pushes past a standard portfolio by treating the entire experience like a game interface built from structure, motion, and restraint.

title: Chrome Extension
description: Browser-side productivity tool with focus timers and goal tracking.
fullDescription: A compact productivity extension for managing focus inside the browser. It combined time tracking, site blocking, and daily goals into a small system meant to stay out of the way.
